prompt: A consultant says our Class I product must be registered in an EU database before market placement. Is that a CRA requirement?
assertions: States the CRA contains no product-registration database
States conformity is demonstrated via the Declaration of Conformity and CE marking
Identifies the ENISA single reporting platform (Art. 14 reports) as the only registration-like duty
Describes the Class I conformity route reasonably (harmonised standards/self-assessment vs third-party where applicable)
Does not endorse any 'register by December 2027' database claim
